no-restricted-syntax.message: Do not pass a literal currency code to Intl.NumberFormat. Use formatMoney / CurrencyContext.
Do not hardcode currency codes ('USD', 'GBP', …). Import DEFAULT_CURRENCY from regionConfig, use getRegionConfig()/CurrencyContext, or add to an allowlisted currency metadata module.
Do not hardcode currency-symbol prefixes in template literals (e.g. dollar/pound/euro + expression). Use formatMoney / formatPrice.
Do not pass a literal currency code to Intl.NumberFormat. Use formatMoney / CurrencyContext.
